compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Jesus rises, removes clothing, takes a towel, pours water, washes, and wipes.
observations.label: Gesture

observations.body: Peter first questions the washing and then asks for hands and head as well as feet.
observations.label: Two objections

observations.body: Lord, Teacher, servant, messenger, knowing, and doing frame the explanation after the washing.
observations.label: Pattern

payload.posture: Attend to the physical sequence, Peter’s changing requests, and the explanation addressed to the whole group.
payload.tension: Peter’s refusal and excess both meet a measured action whose meaning is explained only afterward.
payload.title: Do you wash my feet?
